title: Rehabilitation of Road, Barangay Mojon, City of Malolos, Bulacan
description: REHABILITATION OF ROAD, BARANGAY MOJON, CITY OF MALOLOS, BULACAN
colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.

reasons.title: A bidder's name matches the government blacklist
reasons.detail: WAWAO BUILDERS: matches the GPPB blacklist (name match - verify)
reasons.evidence: Official record (GPPB blacklist, via OpenSanctions). A name match is not proof that it is the same firm.
checks: Open the blacklist entry and compare the licence (PCAB) number, address and company type with the bidder's.
Check that the debarment period covers the bid date; debarments expire.
Check whether the matched firm won or lost; a losing bidder matters less once the contract is awarded.

reasons.title: A bidder is named in an official action
reasons.detail: WAWAO BUILDERS: named in an official action on 23CC0123, status "filed" (2025-09-11; as reported)
more: WAWAO BUILDERS: named in an official action on 23CC0105, status "filed" (2025-09-11; as reported)
reasons.evidence: A referral, charge, audit finding or suspension compiled by the team from a public source; status as reported.
checks: Open the source and confirm it names this firm, with the status word used (referred, charged, filed).
Note the date; check for later developments (dismissal, conviction, lifting of a suspension).

reasons.title: A bidder has a reported link to an official or investigation
reasons.detail: WAWAO BUILDERS: documented link to Mark Allan V. Arevalo (general manager): Testified at the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee that Wawao's licence was 'forcibly used' for certain ghost flood-control projects, named Sally Santos of Syms Construction as the user [testified, 2025-09-08; as reported]
more: WAWAO BUILDERS: documented link to Mark Allan V. Arevalo (general manager): COA fraud audit reports sent to the Ombudsman named Arevalo of Wawao Builders among parties liable over two Calumpit, Bulacan flood-mitigation projects. [referred, 2025-09-08; as reported]
reasons.evidence: From the team's register of company–person links reported in the news or hearings. Reported, not proven.
checks: Read the source article; confirm the link is stated there, not inferred.
Look for an official document (SEC filing, COA report, Ombudsman complaint) that confirms it.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: Wawao Builders (winner): 2 of 33 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

reasons.title: The winner's other projects drew citizen reports
reasons.detail: WAWAO BUILDERS has 4 other DPWH projects reported by citizens (ghost/defective/unfinished tags)
reasons.evidence: A contractor whose other roads drew 2+ citizen reports had about 4.5 times the odds of a report.
checks: Open the winner's reported projects on the DPWH Transparency Portal and read what citizens reported.
Plan a site visit or ask a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, TAPAT) to look once work starts.

tests.text: WAWAO BUILDERS: 6% of its finished DPWH contracts were terminated (5%+ went with about 4x the odds of termination; not yet confirmed on recent years)
